units.title: at/in/on — время
units.shortDescription: At 5 o'clock, in May, on Monday — три предлога времени.
units.theoryHtml:
Три предлога времени — по «размеру» от точного к широкому:

ПредлогКогдаПримеры
atточный моментat 5 o'clock, at noon, at midnight, at night, at the weekend, at Christmas, at the moment
onдни и датыon Monday, on the 5th of June, on my birthday, on Friday morning
inмесяцы, годы, века, части сутокin May, in 2024, in the 21st century, in the morning/afternoon/evening

Ключевое исключение: at night, но in the morning. И: on Friday morning, но in the morning — когда есть день, берём on.

⚠ Частые ошибки: in Monday → on Monday. at the morning → in the morning. in night → at night. В выражениях next/last/this/every предлог не нужен: See you next Monday, I saw her last week.

Мини-диалог:
— When's the meeting? — On Tuesday at three in the afternoon.
— And the party? — At the weekend. Come at seven!

exercises.prompt: My birthday is ___ the 12th of August.

exercises.explanation: День + часть суток — on Saturday morning/evening.

options: I'll call you in next week.
I'll call you at next week.
I'll call you on next week.

exercises.prompt: We always visit my grandparents ___ Christmas.

units.title: at/in/on — место
units.shortDescription: At the bus stop, in the room, on the wall.
units.theoryHtml:
Место подчиняется той же логике «размера»:

ПредлогКогдаПримеры
atточка: конкретное место/событиеat the bus stop, at the door, at work, at a party, at school (учусь)
inвнутри замкнутого пространстваin the room, in a box, in London, in the car, in bed, in the water
onповерхностьon the wall, on the table, on the floor, on a shelf, on the ceiling

Тонкости: in a car / in a taxi, но on a bus / on a train / on a plane (можно ходить внутри); on horseback. at the corner (перекрёсток) vs in the corner of the room (внутри угла).

⚠ Частые ошибки: I'm at home in my room — оба верны, но смысл разный: at home — точка «дома», in my room — внутри комнаты. on the picture → in the picture (изображено внутри).

Мини-диалог:
— Where are you? — I'm at the station, waiting in the coffee shop.
— I see your ticket — it's on the table next to your laptop!

exercises.prompt: We met ___ a conference in Berlin.
I left my umbrella ___ the taxi.
exercises.explanation: in a taxi, но on a bus/train.

exercises.prompt: There's a beautiful painting ___ the wall.
He lives ___ (в) a small flat in the old town.

units.title: to/in/at — направления и заведения
units.shortDescription: go to work, in bed, at university — и когда предлог не нужен.
units.theoryHtml:
С глаголами движения (go, come, walk, drive, fly, return) используем to: go to work, go to school, go to the cinema. Но ряд слов устойчиво БЕЗ to:

  • go home, come home, get home (home — наречие)
  • go to bed — есть to, но bed без артикля

После прибытия (be/stay/work/live) — at/in: be at work, stay at home, be in bed, study at university, be in hospital.

Движение (to)Место (at/in)
go to schoolbe at school
go to workbe at work
go to bedbe in bed

arrive: arrive in (города, страны) / arrive at (места) — но НЕ arrive to: arrive in Paris, arrive at the hotel.

⚠ Частые ошибки: go to home → go home. arrive to London → arrive in London. I'm in work now → I'm at work now.

Мини-диалог:
— Where are you? — I'm at work. I got to the office an hour ago.
— Perfect. And is Tom there? — No, he went home — he wasn't feeling well.

exercises.prompt: He arrived ___ the hotel an hour later.

options: I arrived to the airport early.
I arrived at the airport early.
